name: Stagepay guide handover
target_basis: Working target; the checked event rules specify no numeric limit.

steps.caption: Stagepay keeps a small freelance agreement, its delivery evidence and test-payment decisions in one place.
The client begins by creating a project with a clear scope and separate milestones.
Give this sample guide-writing job a short, clear name.

steps.value: Demo job: deliver a local setup guide, a contract behavior guide, and a handover checklist. Each delivery must link to a real public Markdown file in this repository. These test tokens have no cash value.
steps.caption: Write down what will be delivered and explain that this is a demo job using test tokens.
Name milestone 1 so both people know which piece of work it covers.
Set the number of test tokens held for milestone 1.
Name milestone 2 so both people know which piece of work it covers.
Set the number of test tokens held for milestone 2.
Name milestone 3 so both people know which piece of work it covers.
Set the number of test tokens held for milestone 3.
The client confirms that the tokens have no cash value and a dispute can lock them until both people agree.
Funding sends real transactions to the local chain and waits for the resulting receipt.
Switch to the clearly labelled freelancer role used for this local demonstration.
The freelancer agrees to the exact recorded scope before submitting any work.
The first delivery links to a real but incomplete setup note saved in the repository.

steps.value: Initial demo delivery: basic startup commands. Recovery steps still need to be added.
steps.caption: The delivery note explains what is included without claiming the missing recovery steps are finished.
The freelancer submits this link and note, and the contract records their evidence hash.
Switch back to Client to review the submitted milestone.
The client can request a revision instead of releasing the milestone payment.

steps.value: Please include what to do when a transaction is interrupted.
steps.caption: Ask for the missing interrupted-transaction section so the next delivery has a clear acceptance target.
A revision returns the milestone to pending and leaves the full amount in escrow without paying it.
The freelancer can now submit an updated link and delivery note.
The revised delivery points to the full setup guide, including the interrupted-transaction section.

steps.value: Revised demo delivery: the full guide includes interrupted transactions, preserved records and recovery limits.
steps.caption: Explain the concrete change so the client can check the revised work against the request.
Submit the revised evidence for another client review.
The client reviews the new evidence before making the payment decision.
Acceptance checks the current scope and evidence, then credits the exact 10 DEMO payment once.
Agreement options contain the controls for changing unpaid work or ending the agreement together.
Either party can propose a scope change for the remaining unpaid work.

steps.value: Demo job: keep the accepted setup guide. The behavior guide must explain paused transactions and the limits of recovery. Deliver a handover checklist too. Remaining deliveries must link to real public Markdown files. Test tokens have no cash value.
steps.caption: The new scope keeps the accepted guide and asks for the recovery limits to be included in the behavior guide.
Proposing a new scope does not make it binding until the other person agrees.
Switch to Freelancer to review the exact scope change proposed by the client.
Both people agree to the new scope; accepted work stays paid and unpaid evidence must be submitted again.
The receipt history records the scope change alongside the earlier delivery and payment decisions.

steps.selector: details.receipt:has-text("Both parties agreed to the new scope") > summary
steps.caption: Open the confirmed local receipt to show the actual transaction hash and agreement fingerprint.
The freelancer withdraws available wallet credit while this project keeps its unpaid 25 DEMO in escrow.
The withdrawal is recorded in the same history, and wallet credit shows what remains available.
Export the selected project record with its scope, evidence and receipt history.
These transactions used actual local contracts and demo wallets; public Sepolia deployment is not configured.
This prototype has no cash-value tokens, production login, automatic receipt recovery or outside dispute arbitrator.
